metadata.name: E. fimbriata oocyte and chemical composition data
metadata.description: Dataset containing biological and chemical measurements of E. fimbriata oocytes, including size, volume, lipid and protein content, calorific value, and elemental ratios (Ba/Ca, Sr/Ca, Zn/Ca). Data also includes environmental parameters like temperature and salinity, collected from multiple locations (Foundiougne, Djifer, Joal) in Senegal over several months in 2014.
